findings.issue: Incoming straight conveyor meets straight buffer at a right angle without a curved roller section, directional transfer table/pusher or equivalent turn mechanism.
findings.repair: Use the already designed 90-degree module or explicit powered transfer deck, with continuous supported width through the turn. Gate must remain upstream of buffer.

findings.issue: Buffer terminal has no retaining guard; final tray is aimed into the timber table/leg. Prompt requires a guarded dead end and manual pickup.
findings.repair: Add visible terminal end-stop fence before the counter, leaving a narrow gap to the wood and manual lift access; preserve three tray positions.

findings.issue: Customer-front view rail chevrons point away from the stock-end buffer toward the rear approach, opposite restock flow shown elsewhere.
findings.repair: Remove decorative chevrons or correctly orient all marks from approach to terminal buffer under camera reversal.

findings.issue: Overall views show green lamps with lowered gates while READY detail shows green/raised gate. This could be an intermediate gate cycle, but no such transient is labelled.
findings.repair: Prefer raised gates for overall READY states or label the intended hold state consistently.

findings.issue: Customer-facing register back and staff-facing controls remain at the same physical fixed end. Timber table, legs and shelf retained; buffer at free stock end, staff/customer frontage clear, cash excluded from food belt.
READY detail has two occupied positions and one empty; FULL has three downstream trays with fourth held upstream, no overlap. Staff handoff is explicitly named.

required_repairs: Add terminal end-stop and clearance from wood
approval_boundary: Counter concept and shown states only; not customer AI, working restock, collision or capacity/balance approval.
